description: [STAGE 3: SYNTAX & STACKS] Alias of basecoat_compose_stack. Assemble shell architectures and hydrate pre-configured component stacks into slots.

density.description: Optical spacing density mode. Defaults to standard.

environment.description: Target output environment/framework. Defaults to html.

headerId.description: Optional header stack ID from header-stacks: breadcrumb-command-header, tabs-filter-header, or date-range-export-header.

shellId.description: Shell architecture ID from shell-stacks: sidebar-01..sidebar-16, topbar-shell, inset-shell, or split-shell. Defaults to sidebar-01.

stacks.description: Ordered list or record of component stack IDs to hydrate into the shell slots (e.g., ["kpi-4-col", "area-chart-overview", "data-table-full-crud", "recent-sales-feed", "detail-drawer"]). Also accepts category shorthands: "kpi", "chart", "table", "form", "overlay".

title.description: Optional workspace/page title to inject into the shell header.

name: compose_stack
